steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive sessions online at times that fit your schedule in Oxnard's competitive industries—from aerospace and defense to maritime logistics and healthcare. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay the required PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take Your Exam

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During this cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved project-management activities, training, and contribution to the profession. Renew your credential before expiration to stay current in your career.
